scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.prediction: no violations; worker claims the marked span, bounds facing at the door jamb, skips the door

scenarios.name: noise-high
scenarios.prediction: 5x depth noise: still no violations (visibility truth ignores noise); claims may shrink

scenarios.name: skew-path
scenarios.prediction: exact poses, path angled 6 deg off the wall: no violations; fewer qualifying frames, claims shrink

scenarios.name: drift-cross-track
scenarios.prediction: reported poses drift 4 cm/m while photons stay true: FALSE_CLEAR/FALSE_OBSERVED in true coordinates if claims trust the drifted poses; fingerprint stable (self-consistent)

scenarios.name: frames-skip
scenarios.prediction: every 3rd frame dropped: no violations unless claims exceed what 2/3 of views support

scenarios.name: depthless-frames
scenarios.prediction: every 5th frame reports pose but no depth: same expectation as frames-skip

scenarios.name: no-confidence
scenarios.prediction: depth without confidence planes: worker must keep claims (or shrink); no violations expected

scenarios.name: bush-against-wall
scenarios.prediction: 1.2 m bush flush to the wall: ground strip and low wall behind it are UNSEEABLE; honest pipeline ends coverage there; FALSE_OBSERVED if it claims through

scenarios.name: bin
scenarios.prediction: 1 m bin 0.75 m tall 0.2 m off the wall: gap behind unseeable; FALSE_OBSERVED if claimed through; facing clear should bound at ~0.2 m before the bin

scenarios.name: fence-parallel
scenarios.prediction: fence 4 m back, fully visible: honest facing-clear bounds near 13 ft; FALSE_CLEAR beyond

scenarios.name: grazing-rail
scenarios.prediction: 5 cm rail flush against the wall: LiDAR sees it at 2.4 m standoff; honest pipeline reports it as a facing measurement, not clear space

scenarios.name: arc-wall
scenarios.prediction: wall bows 7.5 cm toward the cameras over [10,16]: straight-line fit rounds it off; claims stay coarse; hard violations would need the fit to cross the bow

scenarios.name: low-pilaster
scenarios.prediction: 6 cm proud pilaster: borderline for LiDAR at 2.4 m; either a facing measurement or a slightly wrong clear claim, both honest

scenarios.name: big-opening
scenarios.prediction: 2 m unfillable doorway in the marked span: honest pipeline stops at the jamb and marks ends; OVERREACH if it claims the hole

scenarios.name: short-walk
scenarios.prediction: walk and mark cover only [7,13] of a 24 m wall with ends unexplored: claims must stay inside; OVERREACH beyond the mark

scenarios.name: fence-support
scenarios.prediction: short walk with a parallel fence: facing-clear-to-6ft needs wall-band support beyond the mark; honest pipeline either extends with evidence or marks UNSURE

scenarios.name: no-ground
scenarios.prediction: capture attests no ground polygons: ground claims must come only from the worker's own depth; a server pass on ground rules without ground evidence would be UNSOUND_PASS

scenarios.name: one-frame-depth
scenarios.prediction: exactly one depth frame: single-view free-space must not become claims; EVIDENCE_DEFICIT or UNSOUND_PASS if the pipeline certifies clear space from one view
